questions.q: Activities on the critical path have a total float of:
questions.explain: Any delay to a critical activity delays the whole project.

questions.q: A (3 d) precedes B (4 d) and C (2 d); D (5 d) follows both B and C. What is the project duration in days?
questions.explain: The longest path is A–B–D: $3 + 4 + 5 = 12$ days.

questions.q: PERT estimates are $a = 2$, $m = 5$, $b = 14$ days. What is the expected time $t_e$?
EV = 40 M and AC = 45 M. What is the CPI? Give 2 decimal places.
questions.explain: $CPI = EV/AC = 40/45 = 0.89$, so the project is over budget.

questions.q: An SPI of 0.8 means the project is:
questions.explain: $SPI = EV/PV < 1$ means less work was done than planned.

questions.q: The 100% rule of a WBS states that:
options: The WBS covers all the project's work and nothing more
The budget must be fully spent
questions.explain: The WBS captures exactly the total scope.

questions.q: The project charter is produced in which phase?
questions.explain: The charter formally authorises the project at initiation.

questions.q: Buying insurance against equipment damage is an example of risk:
questions.explain: The financial impact is transferred to the insurer.
